title: Morrey estimates for the gradient in non-linear variational transmission problems
summary: We study a class of variational transmission problems driven by nonlinear energies with discontinuous coefficients across a prescribed interface. The model setting consists of integral functionals of the form \[ \mathcal{F}(u;E)=\int_Ωσ_E(x)\,F(\nabla u)\,dx, \] where the coefficient $σ_E$ takes two constant values on complementary regions separated by a $C^1$ hypersurface, and the integrand $F$ satisfies standard $p$-growth and monotonicity conditions with $p>2$.
